rate_limits: Fixed numeric limits are intentionally unpublished. Docs advise throttling and not hammering the API; send requests sequentially (one at a time) and, after any 429, wait a full minute before retrying.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Auditor correct. Official Lichess API docs (https://lichess.org/api) state fixed rate limits are not published as fixed numbers; they instruct developers to make only one request at a time and, after a 429, wait a full minute. The original entry’s “~20–30 req/s for some endpoints” is not official published guidance and conflicts with that sequential + 1-minute-after-429 rule.
